name: Release v0.8.8
body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump platformdirs from 4.12.0 to 4.12.1 in the all-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/442
* chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/444
* chore(deps): bump pyjwt from 2.14.0 to 2.15.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/443
* Show AI control, temporarily block physical input, and allow user takeover by @zengfanfan in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/445
* Update dependencies by @temotskipa in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/446
* Fix process-global GetCursorPos argtypes pollution breaking cursor tracking by @iwccx in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/447
* Fix input latency: the hook pump must block, not sleep 10 ms per tick by @iwccx in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/448
* Run UIA-bound tools on the event-loop thread to preserve COM affinity by @legendteddy in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/449
* fix(tree): allow excluding processes from UIA traversal by @legendteddy in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/450
* Run UIA-affine tools on a dedicated worker thread by @legendteddy in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/451
* chore(deps): bump platformdirs from 4.12.2 to 4.12.3 in the all-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/452
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/454
* chore(deps): bump posthog from 7.63.0 to 7.64.1 in the all-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/455

## New Contributors
* @iwccx made their first contribution in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/447
* @legendteddy made their first contribution in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/449

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/compare/v0.8.7...v0.8.8
